lever: Measure production input/output tokens and billed failures
savings_mechanism: Replaces speculative token assumptions with p50/p90/p99 cost per successful player turn and exposes retry waste.
trust_effect: Positive — honest capacity decisions use actual service cost rather than vague scarcity.
implementation_guardrail: Log token counts, provider cost, success/failure, player-cap refund, model ID, and feature class without storing more narrative content than needed.
measurement: GBP per successful player turn; billed failures as percent of attempts; p50/p90 input and output tokens.
do_not_do: Do not cut player caps from the long-context sensitivity before logs show it is representative.

lever: Set a hard prompt-context budget with protected fact lanes
savings_mechanism: Prevents repeated prose and stale history from expanding input tokens while preserving required snapshot facts.
trust_effect: Positive if protected facts are never dropped and the player sees no continuity loss.
implementation_guardrail: Compact descriptive history before factual state; maintain explicit protected fields for inventory, people, location, time, weather, exits, and accepted tasks.
measurement: Input tokens per turn; continuity repairs per 1,000 turns; cost saved versus uncapped context.
do_not_do: Do not summarize away the facts that power the shipped hard gates.

lever: Cache stable model prefixes where the selected route supports it
evidence_status: PUBLICLY EVIDENCED price capability; INPUT REQUIRED hit rate
savings_mechanism: Uses lower cache-read pricing for unchanged policy and stable instruction prefixes.
trust_effect: Neutral to positive because output policy stays unchanged.
implementation_guardrail: Keep volatile snapshot and player text outside the cached prefix; monitor route-specific cache billing rather than assuming every provider caches.
measurement: Cache hit rate; effective input USD per million; latency impact.
do_not_do: Do not count theoretical cache savings before invoices show cache hits.

lever: Pin exact model IDs and enforce a price ceiling
evidence_status: PUBLICLY EVIDENCED current model IDs; SPECULATIVE savings
savings_mechanism: Avoids accidental migration to a more expensive alias, premium route, or promotional price that later changes.
trust_effect: Positive — predictable model identity and spend reduce surprise downgrades.
implementation_guardrail: Use the dated exact IDs in `model_price_reference.csv`; alert on price change and fail safely to the founder-approved route.
measurement: Requests by exact model ID; effective price per million; route variance.
do_not_do: Do not silently switch the Free tier to a different writer because its list price is temporarily lower.

lever: Deduplicate and make turn submission idempotent
savings_mechanism: Stops double-clicks, reconnects, and client retries from creating duplicate billed generations.
trust_effect: Positive — prevents duplicate story events and cap confusion.
implementation_guardrail: Assign one client-visible turn identity; a repeated submission returns the existing result rather than generating again.
measurement: Duplicate attempt rate; avoided calls; duplicate-story incidents.
do_not_do: Do not charge or consume the cap twice for one confirmed player action.

lever: Budget retries and fallbacks separately from player turns
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder rule; INPUT REQUIRED failure rate
savings_mechanism: Limits hidden multi-attempt spend and makes the cost of refunded failed turns visible.
trust_effect: Positive if failures refund the player cap and the UI tells the truth.
implementation_guardrail: Set an operations ceiling per request; distinguish no-output failures from usable completions; expose paid retries in telemetry.
measurement: Attempts per successful turn; provider cost of refunded turns; failure recovery rate.
do_not_do: Do not imply a refunded player turn also refunded provider spend.

lever: Constrain output by completed narrative beat, not arbitrary truncation
savings_mechanism: Avoids overlong completions that repeat description after the choice pressure is clear.
trust_effect: Positive when endings remain complete and never stop mid-sentence or before the next choice.
implementation_guardrail: Set a generous maximum, instruct for one coherent beat, and detect finish quality; tune from output-token histograms.
measurement: Output tokens per successful turn; mid-sentence rate; player continue/regenerate signals.
do_not_do: Do not make Free prose visibly skeletal while advertising the same experience.

lever: Keep memorable image generation OFF by default
savings_mechanism: Prevents automatic image-generation spend for Free sessions.
trust_effect: Positive — no surprise wait, charge, or content change; text remains the core product.
implementation_guardrail: Offer memorable plates only through an explicit eligible action; state availability and any quota before generation.
measurement: Image calls per MAU; opt-in rate; cost per generated plate; cancellation rate.
do_not_do: Do not auto-generate images after emotional moments or in Kid Mode.

lever: Gate Klein icon generation behind explicit founder-controlled budgets
evidence_status: EVIDENCED that Klein may bill; INPUT REQUIRED actual price
savings_mechanism: Prevents theme/icon generation experiments from leaking into recurring player-turn cost.
trust_effect: Positive if generation is an admin/design action rather than a hidden live dependency.
implementation_guardrail: Separate design-time and live-call credentials, budgets, alerts, and environments; prefer shipped static assets once approved.
measurement: Klein calls by environment; cost per accepted asset; rejected-generation ratio.
do_not_do: Do not regenerate routine icons per player, session, or theme load.

lever: Make opening setup a single durable game event
evidence_status: EVIDENCED founder decision; SPECULATIVE implementation savings
savings_mechanism: Avoids paying again when a player revisits, refreshes, or reopens the same New Game setup.
trust_effect: Positive — the same opening remains stable and the player’s initial facts persist.
implementation_guardrail: Generate once after confirmed New Game creation; retrieve the accepted opening on reload; create a new call only for an explicit new game.
measurement: Opening calls per new game; duplicate opening calls; refresh-related spend.
do_not_do: Do not quietly rewrite the opening on refresh.

lever: Batch credit purchases above the minimum-fee distortion
savings_mechanism: Spreads the $0.80 minimum credit-purchase fee across more inference spend when monthly usage is tiny.
trust_effect: Neutral — a treasury operation with no player-facing degradation.
implementation_guardrail: Set a modest replenishment threshold and spend alert; avoid holding an unnecessarily large prepaid balance.
measurement: Effective platform fee percent; minimum-fee dollars per month; unused credit balance.
do_not_do: Do not overbuy credits merely to make the percentage look lower.

lever: Offer ads only as optional overflow, never as a forced gate
savings_mechanism: May subsidize extra voluntary Free turns without reducing the included allowance.
trust_effect: Conditionally neutral only when refusal is easy and privacy disclosures are clear.
implementation_guardrail: Never show in Kid Mode, never mid-action, never disguise an ad as a story choice, and preserve the base allowance without ad viewing.
measurement: Opt-in rate; incremental turns; complaints; privacy-consent completion; revenue net of SDK cost.
do_not_do: Do not force ads, place them during a scene, sell narrative influence, or claim ad viewing improves memory.

lever: Evaluate BYOK only for controlled back-office workloads
savings_mechanism: Could avoid OpenRouter BYOK fees within the plan allowance, but does not inherently reduce provider inference cost.
trust_effect: Neutral if invisible to players and reliability remains equal.
implementation_guardrail: Use only after comparing operational complexity, provider terms, privacy, rate limits, and failover; keep live-player routing explicit.
measurement: All-in provider plus operations cost; error rate; latency; engineering hours.
do_not_do: Do not present BYOK as free inference or move player data without processor review.
